newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora also postpones pulp price rise.
newsitem.headline: Stora also postpones pulp price rise.

text.p: Swedish forestry company Stora AB on Tuesday said it hopes to be able to raise elementary chlorine free (ECF) pulp prices to $610 per tonne in February from $560, after failing to see through this hike on January 1.
"But it is hard to say at the moment, after the holidays," Lennart Holm, president of Stora unit Stora Cell, told Reuters.
He said the situation should be clearer in a week or two.
"The positive thing is that we now see customers at full capacity utilization so a price hike will come sooner or later," he said.
Earlier on Tuesday, Swedish forestry cooperative Sodra Skogsagarna announced it was postponing a planned rise in prices to $610 a tonne until February.
Swedish forestry group MoDo, did not want to comment.
But a spokeswoman said that as MoDo had not announced a price hike, it had nothing to withdraw.
